name: Show-Log
label: Show-Log: the device log as a sheet over Shortcuts (2 actions)

p.WFCommentActionText: A hosted https URL, not HTML text, and the difference decides whether this works at all. Show Web View takes either, but HTML text lands at a file:// origin, a different storage partition, where localStorage.ghToken is not; a plain https URL keeps the page on its own origin and the stored token with it. Measured 2026-08-26 by Probe-WebViewCaps, and Dictate already takes this route. One action, because the page does the work.
